notes: Fix: full-screen portals stay full screen. OLED shift (on by default for Omen since 1.1.1034) moved each portal to a position it had recorded long before, which opened a gap along the top and left of a full-screen portal and let it drift…

Fix: portals no longer grow past the edge of their monitor. On screens above 100% scale each OLED shift and each full-screen exit grew the window by 1 to 3 pixels; the size is now held exactly, and leaving full screen returns to the size…

Fix: a full-screen portal keeps its whole display after sleep or a screen change, and after a restart. The full-screen button fills the display; pressed again it returns to the previous size. Place on display ends full screen first.

scripts/placement-rig.js now also checks OLED shift (size held, within 3 px, exact on off), full screen through OLED, a wake and a restart, and that repeated full-screen presses never grow the portal. It passes on 100%, 125% and 150%…
